description.value: Sushi Main is a Japanese restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street corridor offering a broad menu of sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, donburi, teriyaki, and noodle dishes. The restaurant serves both dine-in and online delivery orders, with a free delivery radius of 3 km. It sits in the lively Main Street neighbourhood, a natural waypoint for cyclists touring south Vancouver.
